newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-SSAB Q1 profit seen 44 pct lower.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-SSAB Q1 profit seen 44 pct lower.

text.p: Swedish steel group SSAB was expected to report a lower pre-tax profit of 470 million crowns for the first quarter of 1997, a Reuters poll of 11 analysts found on Friday.
In the same period a year ago, SSAB reported a profit of 844 million crowns so the average of the forecast would mean a fall of 44 percent.
For the 1997 calendar year SSAB was forecast to post a profit of 2.19 billion crowns and profit per share of 12.50 crowns.
SSAB will release its first quarter report on April 24.
Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aragon, Aros, Carnegie, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Enskilda, Handelsbanken, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Norske Bank, Penser, Societe Generale and Swedbank.
